requirements.requirement: The system must map explicit dataset value 'accepting_new_patients = true' to new_patient_acceptance = 'yes'.
The system must map explicit dataset value 'accepting_new_patients = false' to new_patient_acceptance = 'no'.
The system must assign new_patient_acceptance = 'unknown' when no acceptance-related field is present in the dataset.
The system must normalize non-boolean acceptance values (e.g., 'Y','Yes','1') to 'yes' using deterministic mapping rules.
The system must normalize non-boolean acceptance values (e.g., 'N','No','0') to 'no' using deterministic mapping rules.
The system must apply a consistent precedence order when multiple acceptance signals exist, prioritizing explicit flags over inferred signals.
The system must assign new_patient_acceptance = 'unknown' when conflicting explicit signals are present and cannot be resolved by precedence rules.
The system must infer new_patient_acceptance = 'no' when provider status indicates closed panel or equivalent exclusion condition.
The system must infer new_patient_acceptance = 'yes' when provider status indicates open panel or equivalent inclusion condition and no explicit flag exists.
The system must ensure that the same input dataset always produces the same new_patient_acceptance output (deterministic behavior).
The system must log the source of the acceptance determination (explicit, inferred, or defaulted) for each provider record.
The system must handle null, empty, or malformed acceptance fields without runtime failure and default to 'unknown'.
The system must process all provider records in the ingestion batch without skipping records due to missing acceptance data.
The system must support extension of inference rules without modifying existing mappings for current accepted values.
